title: S035 8.1.1 Optional Events Linked to Optional Session Attributes
parent_path: S035 8.1.1 Optional Events Linked to Optional Session Attributes

statements.subject: session
statements.description: IdleHoldTime specifies the length of time the BGP peer is held in the Idle state prior to allowing the next automatic restart. The IdleHoldTimer is the timer that holds the peer in Idle state.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: Normally, a Detect Collision (see Section 6.8) will be ignored in the Established state. The CollisionDetectEstablishedState optional session attribute indicates that this BGP connection processes collisions in the Established state.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: AllowAutomaticStart attribute specifies that this BGP connection supports automatic starting of the BGP connection.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: AllowAutomaticStop optional attribute indicates that the BGP connection allows automatic stopping of the BGP connection under the control of implementation-specific logic.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The DampPeerOscillations optional session attribute indicates that the BGP connection is using logic that damps BGP peer oscillations in the Idle State.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The IdleHoldTime is the value that is set in the IdleHoldTimer.

statements.subject: timer
statements.description: The IdleHoldTimer aids in controlling BGP peer oscillation. The IdleHoldTimer is used to keep the BGP peer in Idle for a particular duration. The IdleHoldTimer_Expires event is described in Section 8.1.3.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The AcceptConnectionsUnconfiguredPeers optional session attribute allows the FSM to support the state transitions that allow the implementation to accept or reject unconfigured peers.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: PassiveTcpEstablishment option indicates that the BGP FSM will passively wait for the remote BGP peer to establish the BGP TCP connection.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The BGP FSM normally tracks the end result of a TCP connection attempt rather than individual TCP messages. Optionally, the BGP FSM can support additional interaction with the TCP connection negotiation via TrackTcpState.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The DelayOpen optional session attribute allows implementations to be configured to delay sending an OPEN message for a specific time period (DelayOpenTime). The delay allows the remote BGP Peer time to send the first OPEN message.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The DelayOpenTime is the initial value set in the DelayOpenTimer.

statements.subject: timer
statements.description: The DelayOpenTimer optional session attribute is used to delay the sending of an OPEN message on a connection. The DelayOpenTimer_Expires event (Event 12) is described in Section 8.1.3.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The SendNOTIFICATIONwithoutOPEN allows a peer to send a NOTIFICATION without first sending an OPEN message. Without this optional session attribute, the BGP connection assumes that an OPEN message must be sent by a peer prior to the peer sending a NOTIFICATION message.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: CollisionDetectEstablishedState optional session attribute indicates that this BGP connection processes collisions in the Established state. Normally, a Detect Collision will be ignored in the Established state.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: IdleHoldTime specifies the length of time the BGP peer is held in the Idle state prior to allowing the next automatic restart. The IdleHoldTimer is the timer that holds the peer in Idle state.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: Normally, a Detect Collision will be ignored in the Established state. The CollisionDetectEstablishedState optional session attribute indicates that this BGP connection processes collisions in the Established state.
